query: What effect sizes and sample sizes are appropriate for experiments testing whether advice-based manipulations materially reduce detector performance?

response.query: What effect sizes and sample sizes are appropriate for experiments testing whether advice-based manipulations materially reduce detector performance?
response.answer: For experiments testing advice-based manipulations on detector performance, a medium effect size (Cohen's d ≈ 0.5) and a sample size of at least 120 participants are typically recommended to achieve adequate power.

results.title: Preventing Access to U.S. Sensitive Personal Data and ...
results.content: On February 28, 2024, the President issued [Executive Order 14117](/executive-order/14117) (Preventing Access to Americans' Bulk Sensitive Personal Data and United States Government-Related Data by Countries of Concern) (“the Order”), pursuant to his authority under the Constitution and the laws of the United States, including the International Emergency Economic Powers Act, [50 U.S.C. 1701](https://www.govinfo.gov/link/uscode/50/1701) *et seq.* (“IEEPA”); the National Emergencies Act, [50 U.S.C. 1601](https://www.govinfo.gov/link/uscode/50/1601) *et seq.* (“NEA”); and title 3, section 301 of the United States Code.[[4](#footnote-4-p1637)]  In the Order, the President expanded the scope of the national emergency declared in [Executive Order 13873](/executive-order/13873) of May 15, 2019 (Securing the Information and Communications Technology and Services Supply Chain), and further addressed with additional measures in [Executive Order 14034](/executive-order/14034) of June 9, 2021 (Protecting Americans' Sensitive Data From Foreign Adversaries).
